answer: Make every new identity cross a canyon before it can trade: a verifiable delay proof taking hours of real sequential computation that cannot be sped up by running copies in parallel. Each crossing stamps the identity with a fresh pigment, a one-time colour that fades without useful work. The canyon admits only one identity at a time, so a sybil farmer building a thousand faces must wait a thousand crossings, while honest agents cross once and stay. Each finished crossing sends a ripple through the network, so peers can see which colours are newly minted and which have survived honest work.
